instruction: The file transactions.csv has columns txn_id,amount. Every amount is a positive integer. Find a set of distinct transactions whose amounts add up to exactly 1000. How many transactions are in the set? Use bash with python3 to compute it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
